heading: Monday, June 12, 2023
topLine: Terence Tao predicts AI could be a 'trustworthy co-author' by 2026.

items.headline: Terence Tao predicts AI could be a 'trustworthy co-author' by 2026
items.summary: In an essay for Microsoft's AI Anthology, Fields medallist Terence Tao wrote that 2023-era AI already offers mathematicians hints and leads, and that 2026-level AI, combined with proof verifiers and search, could become a "trustworthy co-author". He also warned that convincing-looking LLM mathematics needs line-by-line checking, and that journals may have to change their practices.
